scope: Operation editing and ORBAT interaction performance; aesthetics and theme customization remain deferred
changes: Build live document previews only when their view is active, and reuse the result until its source, profile, configuration, assets or layout changes.
Reuse operation validation and dirty comparisons on unchanged state, while validating every actual operation edit.
Reuse working-copy serialization when the immutable source/value objects are unchanged; retain the existing recovery queue and close guards.
Reuse saved ORBAT validation and dirty comparisons between selections.
Index ORBAT node lookup and sibling ordering; compute valid parent choices only in Change parent mode.
Use one node-name lookup map when applying graphic selection accessibility attributes.
Add a reproducible isolated desktop benchmark with preview, retained-export, selection, parent-change and undo assertions.

benchmark.fixture: Three fictional demo operations, each with 400 additional tasks, and a 127-unit binary ORBAT with military symbols.
benchmark.methodology: 12 text-input-to-second-animation-frame samples and 12 ORBAT-selection-to-second-animation-frame samples per run. Timed samples run before precise coverage; pooled final medians are recomputed from 24 samples using the conventional mean of the two middle values.
benchmark.limitations: Local development-build measurements on one machine. Cold startup and first ORBAT render varied considerably, so no startup or cold-render speed claim is made.
benchmark.deferredLoadingExperiment: Removed from the final implementation because it delayed first operation opening and individual rich-text lazy loading exposed a mount timing error. The original application loading path is restored exactly.

Role add, duplicate, reorder and remove work in the dedicated editor; both views fit desktop and narrower layouts

Two organizations sharing the same ORBAT keep different unit identities and personnel
